allow: Bash(awk '/^v / {n++; if\(n==1\){minx=$2;maxx=$2;miny=$3;maxy=$3;minz=$4;maxz=$4} if\($2<minx\)minx=$2; if\($2>maxx\)maxx=$2; if\($3<miny\)miny=$3; if\($3>maxy\)maxy=$3; if\($4<minz\)minz=$4; if\($4>maxz\)maxz=$4} END {printf "verts=%d\\n", n; printf "X: %.4f .. %.4f  \(size %.4f, center %.4f\)\\n", minx,maxx,maxx-minx,\(minx+maxx\)/2; printf "Y: %.4f .. %.4f  \(size %.4f, center %.4f\)\\n", miny,maxy,maxy-miny,\(miny+maxy\)/2; printf "Z: %.4f .. %.4f  \(size %.4f, center %.4f\)\\n", minz,maxz,maxz-minz,\(minz+maxz\)/2}' heaterready.obj)
Bash(awk '/^v / {b=int\($4\); c[b]++} END {for\(i=-4;i<=5;i++\) printf "z[%3d, %3d\): %d\\n", i, i+1, c[i]}' heaterready.obj)
Bash(awk '/^v / {b=int\($3\); c[b]++} END {for\(i=-4;i<=4;i++\) printf "y[%3d, %3d\): %d\\n", i, i+1, c[i]}' heaterready.obj)

Bash(awk '/^v / && $4<1.5 {n++; if\(n==1\){minx=$2;maxx=$2;miny=$3;maxy=$3;minz=$4;maxz=$4} if\($2<minx\)minx=$2; if\($2>maxx\)maxx=$2; if\($3<miny\)miny=$3; if\($3>maxy\)maxy=$3; if\($4<minz\)minz=$4; if\($4>maxz\)maxz=$4} END {printf "verts=%d  X:%.3f..%.3f\(%.3f\)  Y:%.3f..%.3f\(%.3f\)  Z:%.3f..%.3f\(%.3f\)\\n", n,minx,maxx,maxx-minx,miny,maxy,maxy-miny,minz,maxz,maxz-minz}' heaterready.obj)

Bash(awk '/^v / && $4>=1.5 {n++; if\(n==1\){minx=$2;maxx=$2;miny=$3;maxy=$3;minz=$4;maxz=$4} if\($2<minx\)minx=$2; if\($2>maxx\)maxx=$2; if\($3<miny\)miny=$3; if\($3>maxy\)maxy=$3; if\($4<minz\)minz=$4; if\($4>maxz\)maxz=$4} END {printf "verts=%d  X:%.3f..%.3f\(%.3f\)  Y:%.3f..%.3f\(%.3f\)  Z:%.3f..%.3f\(%.3f\)\\n", n,minx,maxx,maxx-minx,miny,maxy,maxy-miny,minz,maxz,maxz-minz}' heaterready.obj)

Bash(awk '/^v / {z=$4; x=$2; y=$3; b=int\(\(z+4.0\)/0.5\); cnt[b]++; if\(z<lo[b]||lo[b]==""\){} ; zmin[b]=\(zmin[b]==""||z<zmin[b]\)?z:zmin[b]; zmax[b]=\(zmax[b]==""||z>zmax[b]\)?z:zmax[b]; xmn[b]=\(xmn[b]==""||x<xmn[b]\)?x:xmn[b]; xmx[b]=\(xmx[b]==""||x>xmx[b]\)?x:xmx[b]; ymn[b]=\(ymn[b]==""||y<ymn[b]\)?y:ymn[b]; ymx[b]=\(ymx[b]==""||y>ymx[b]\)?y:ymx[b]} END { for\(i=0;i<=30;i++\) if\(cnt[i]>0\) printf "z[%.2f..%.2f] n=%4d  Xw=%.2f Yh=%.2f\\n", zmin[i], zmax[i], cnt[i], xmx[i]-xmn[i], ymx[i]-ymn[i] }' heaterready.obj)
